set.body:
Goal: make the supported workflow usable without overstating native EDF capability.

Acceptance criteria:
- Guide starts with EDF backup, explicit EDF2ASC conversion, ASC ingest, validation report inspection, clock synchronization, and monocular/binocular selection.
- It distinguishes native EDF, EDF-derived ASC, Data Viewer Sample Reports, generic delimited import, and BIDS.
- Examples compile and use real public or deidentified fixtures.
- Supported/unsupported matrix and validation-artifact link are visible near the first example.
- Guidance explains native EyeLink events versus eyes4s detections, GAZE/HREF/RAW, missing versus Blink, pupil units, message offsets, observed timelines, and converter provenance.
- Failure examples show line-numbered diagnostics and retained unknown records.
- README and io README status language is reconciled with implemented capability and pre-alpha maturity.
set.title: Write the task-first EyeLink import and support guide
